(The content on the pages still consists of incomprehensible symbols, letters, ancient languages, and geometric figures. But a period of focus seems to gradually render their meaning comprehensible.)
{NICKNAME}, are you still going to meditate?

dialogue.sit: I'm going to need you to give me another moment, Paimon.

dialogue.t: Uh... Okay then! It's just a blink of an eye anyway. Paimon's not worried at all!
Still, be careful, {NICKNAME}.
(The edges of the pages blur gradually. A profoundly unfamiliar yet familiar world enters your field of vision. Here...)
Okay!
(The content on the pages still consists of incomprehensible symbols, letters, ancient languages, and geometric figures. But a period of focus seems to gradually render their meaning comprehensible.)
{NICKNAME}, are you ready? Paimon will wait here for you!
(The edges of the pages blur gradually. A profoundly unfamiliar yet familiar world enters your field of vision. Here...)
Mr.(Ms.) {NICKNAME}? Didn't we just see each other?
Hmm, I'm not sure. After all, it's hard to keep track of time in a place like this.

dialogue.sit: Something about this place doesn't feel right.

dialogue.t: Hmm, but don't we get to decide what feels right or not?
Um, I didn't mean to be so deep. But I really like this place. It's full of life and colors, things I've never seen on the other side.
Really? Wow! Where?
Okay! I'm going there now!
Mr.(Ms.) {NICKNAME}! Wait, why isn't Paimon with you?

dialogue.sit: That rift... What are you looking at?

dialogue.t: What rift? Isn't this a mirror?
Well, speaking of that, there is something that I've been looking for.
I'm trying to find clues to the Looking Glass. It looks like a painting, and lets people meditate in a similar manner to the Book of Revealing.

dialogue.sit: About the four orthants and the painting in the Tower of Gestalt...

dialogue.t: ...Really? So it's in a place like that? Okay! Thank you, Mr.(Ms.) {NICKNAME}.
Thanks, Mr.(Ms.) {NICKNAME}.
I don't know. I just wanted to see the blooming sunflowers and the cute puppy...
But a monster came after me, and the sky got darker. I heard many voices talking about things that I didn't understand.
I was scared, so I followed the golden light and ran forward.
The world got a little darker whenever the monster came near. The garden, the palace, the great trees, and the flowers all disappeared. It was very gloomy, and I only saw ruins...
And then the monster caught up to me...

dialogue.sit: You don't have to worry now.

dialogue.t: Don't come around here anymore, little one. There's nothing here, but there's a whole world waiting for you out there.
Huh? Are you the puppy? But...
...Will I see you again? Will this world become a beautiful garden again?
No. Goodbye.
And you, let me ask you one more time. What am I in your eyes?
That's good. You just got rid of someone who shouldn't be here, and thanks to you, this world's collapse has stopped.
But it is unwise for any of you to stay all the same.

dialogue.sit: I figured as much. Please send me back.

dialogue.t: A wise choice. Farewell.
Whoa!
That was super fast! Paimon didn't even have time to blink...
Alright! Our little troublemaker's back! Canotila, you made {NICKNAME} really worried, you know?
*sob* I'm sorry...
Huh? Paimon's not blaming you! Don't cry, Canotila. Come on, Paimon will give you something delicious to eat...
(What happened?)
Don't cry, Canotila, you're a brave, brave Melusine! Here, this is Paimon's favorite Chicken-Mushroom Skewer. Take it, it's all yours!
*sob* Thank you so much, Paimon...
*chewing*
Whoa, such a strange taste! So this is what humans eat for their meals...
Hey! If you don't want it, you can just give it back to Paimon!
But... Thank you. And thank you for saving me, Mr.(Ms.) {NICKNAME}!

dialogue.sit: What do you plan to do next?

dialogue.t: I don't know, but I don't want to read books anymore.
...Canotila, isn't that a bit extreme?
Well, um... The Book of Revealing is really scary...
(So, what exactly happened?)

dialogue.sit: (You'd only understand if you were there.)
(It's a good thing you didn't go.)

dialogue.t: (What do you mean? Ugh, Paimon's getting annoyed...)
...Anyway, I don't want to stay here anymore. I want to live with everyone in Merusea Village.
That's right! The other Melusines will take good care of you!
Thank you, Mr.(Ms.) {NICKNAME}, Paimon.
(test)真神奇
